content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I want to connect my [product_name] [article_no] to [product_name], but I'm not sure how to proceed. I've connected my [product_name] to the PC, and the connection seems fine. In [product_name], under tag management, I selected the S7 protocol suite and TCP/IP, then entered my PC's IP address for the connection. After that, I created input and output tags. However, when I start the runtime in [product_name], there is no connection between my [product_name] and [product_name]. I need urgent help with this.
Please refer to this [company_name] website: [url]. There is an example for HMI communication starting from [product_name] [version_no] ([document]).
A new question published by [user_name] has been split into a different thread with the subject 'Connect [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] [version_no]'. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble setting up communication between [product_name] ([version_no]/[article_no]) and [product_name]. There is confusion about configuration steps within [product_name], particularly regarding protocols and addressing, and users find a lack of clear, easy-to-follow guidance from [company_name] for this situation. Available resources mainly focus on newer software versions, leaving users uncertain about integrating [product_name] with classic versions. The urgency and absence of step-by-step troubleshooting are causing frustration and preventing successful integration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a smooth and easy integration process between [product_name] ([version_no]/[article_no]) and [product_name], including clear setup instructions and effective runtime communication for tag management and HMI functionality.
